mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is 57 degrees under overcast skies near City Hall. We are enjoying a full moon tonight, and the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain expected.

Construction updates for Highway M indicate that a section near the new Aldi site will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work. Additionally, the City of Verona reminds all residents to beware of online scams regarding planning or zoning fees; all payments must be made by check at the City Administration Building.

Today is packed with local events including the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 or test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia on September 29.

On September 5, Verona police officers encountered a series of reports involving cheese slices being placed on vehicle windshields, which they identified as a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
